description:
Found by the s423 (#418) companion A/B; PRE-EXISTING and identical for ASCII
names, which is why it only became VISIBLE now (see "why it surfaced" below).

    our $J = 1;
    local *J = *J;
    print defined $J ? $J : "undef", "\n";
    # perl: 1        PCL: undef

perl localizes the GLOB and immediately assigns the same glob back, so every
slot (SCALAR/ARRAY/HASH/CODE) still points at the same containers.  PCL saves
and restores something that does not carry the slots, so after the statement
the scalar (and array, and hash) read undef.  The three-slot form is perl's
own idiom for "localize this glob without losing what is in it":

    our $J=1; our %J=(a=>1); our @J=(1);
    local *J = *J;
    *J = sub {};                      # replaces only the CODE slot
    print $J, $J{a}, $J[0], "\n";     # perl: 111   PCL: (all undef)

That second form is t/uni/gv.t lines 224-228 ("[ID 20010526.001 (#7038)]
localized glob loses value when assigned to") and its ASCII twin t/op/gv.t.

WHY IT SURFACED IN s423: before #418, the fullwidth `*ï¼ª` glob and the
`$ï¼ª`/`@ï¼ª`/`%ï¼ª` cells were DIFFERENT CL symbols (the reader NFKC-folded and
case-inverted the bare token; the runtime string did not), so the broken
glob-local could not reach the cells and the three rows passed BY ACCIDENT.
Now that both sides spell the name the same way, the fullwidth case behaves
exactly like its ASCII twin â i.e. wrong.  t/uni/gv.t 53/28 -> 50/31, spliced
into docs/perl-suite-run.tsv with this cause.  The three rows are ACCIDENTAL
passes, not a regression of #418 (same family as the s418 bless.t/split.t
un-drops).

Fix shape (not designed): find what `local *NAME` saves and restores in the
runtime and make it a glob whose slots are the live containers, the way
`*NAME = *NAME` does outside a local.  Probe first: `local *J;` (no
assignment) vs `local *J = *J;` vs `local *J = *K;` â perl differs in all
three, and the ASCII t/op/gv.t rows are the acceptance set.

Reproducers: the two programs above; both are ASCII, both fail identically
with fullwidth names.
title: local *NAME = *NAME loses the glob's scalar/array/hash slots
